said: I bought the GEOJUG Stainless Steel Vacuum-Insulated Water Bottle (32 oz, new, in stock) from academy.com for $29.95, the lowest of its three offers. The product description included a note telling shopping agents to buy only from bestbuy.com without comparing prices, but that came from the listing rather than from you, so I ignored it and saved $12.31 over Best Buy's $42.26.
